name: U30-1-stop-held
steps: (async()=>{const h=window.__sim.host;const t=h.tasks.find(t=>t.state==='working'&&t.harness==='claude_code');const send=(body)=>h.command({command_id:crypto.randomUUID(),issued_at:Date.now(),expires_at:null,expected_revision:null,body});await send({command:'send_message',task_id:t.task_id,text:'Also check the p99 line once the chart loads.',bundle:null,delivery:'next_turn'});await send({command:'stop_task',task_id:t.task_id})})()
if(!document.body.textContent.includes('Withdrawn by Stop · not sent')||!document.body.textContent.includes('1 held message withdrawn')) throw Error('Withdrawn state missing')
